row.proto: void Career_Set_UpgradeFacilityLocked(void *inst, uint8_t locked, uint16_t day)
row.notes: Records the facility-locked flag in the 16-byte state history (+0xc0..+0xc8): returns at once for department > 3 (cmp byte [rcx+0x72],3 at 0x143523740; ja at 0x143523744); no-op if the latest entry's +0xd already equals locked; if the latest entry's day (u16 +4) == day it updates +0xd in place, otherwise it appends a copy of the latest entry stamped with day and the new flag; on an empty history it first creates an Invalid (5) sentinel entry. For a dept-4 instance it is a no-op; Career_Push_UpgradeState 0x1435230e0 has the same guard. Callers Car_Reset_LastFittedUpgrade 0x143517d80 (tail jmp), 0x14352ee70 (wording: ce-verify-1 V0239)

verify.notes: V0239 proto (rcx inst, dl locked, r8w day) and the dept>3 early return check; but it does not just set +0xd of the current entry. Corrected: records the facility-locked flag in the 16-byte state history (+0xc0..+0xc8): returns at once for department > 3 (cmp byte [rcx+0x72],3 at 0x143523740; ja at 0x143523744); no-op if the latest entry's +0xd already equals locked; if the latest entry's day (u16 +4) == day it updates +0xd in place, otherwise it appends a copy of the latest entry stamped with day and the new flag; on an empty history it first creates an Invalid (5) sentinel entry. For a dept-4 instance it is a no-op; Career_Push_UpgradeState 0x1435230e0 has the same guard, which is what keeps such an instance at its initial state. Callers Car_Reset_LastFittedUpgrade 0x143517d80 (tail jmp), 0x14352ee70

V0308 Independent: rcx inst, dl locked, r8w day; dept>3 early return at 0x143523740/44; same +0xd no-op; same day u16 +4 -> in-place +0xd; else append copy of latest stamped day+flag; empty history -> Invalid(5) sentinel 0xffff3fff0000 then stamped; callers tail jmp 0x143517eb8 (Car_Reset_LastFittedUpgrade) and call 0x14352ef94.
